Class RmiViewAdapter

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.network.server.RmiViewAdapter
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualView
public class RmiViewAdapter extends Object implements VirtualView
Server-side adapter that wraps a single client's VirtualViewRmi remote callback and exposes it through the technology-agnostic VirtualView interface.

This class has two responsibilities beyond simple delegation:

  • Asynchronous, ordered delivery: every show*/reportError call is submitted to a dedicated single-thread ExecutorService. The calling thread (typically MesosServer's broadcast loop) returns immediately without waiting for the RMI call to complete, while the single-thread executor guarantees that notifications are delivered to this client in the same order they were submitted.
  • Disconnection detection: a ScheduledExecutorService pings the client every 3 seconds via VirtualViewRmi.ping(). A RemoteException from the heartbeat — or from any queued notification — is treated as a disconnection and triggers handleDisconnect() exactly once, guarded by the AtomicBoolean disconnected flag.

  • Method Details

    • startHeartbeat

      public void startHeartbeat()
      Schedules a recurring task that calls VirtualViewRmi.ping() on the client every 3 seconds.

      If a ping throws RemoteException, the client is considered disconnected and handleDisconnect() is invoked.

    • showGameDelta

      public void showGameDelta(GameDelta delta) throws Exception
      Pushes an incremental state update to this client.

      Submits the delivery of delta to the dedicated executor and returns immediately. If the underlying remote call fails with RemoteException, the client is treated as disconnected via handleDisconnect().

      Specified by:
      showGameDelta in interface VirtualView
      Parameters:
      delta - the change to apply to the client's local game state
      Throws:
      Exception - if the notification cannot be delivered (e.g. the client has disconnected)

    • showInitialSnapshot

      public void showInitialSnapshot(GameSnapshot snapshot) throws Exception
      Pushes a full game snapshot to this client, replacing its local state entirely.

      Used both when a game starts (broadcast to all players) and when a player reconnects after a server crash (sent individually).

      Submits the delivery of snapshot to the dedicated executor and returns immediately. If the underlying remote call fails with RemoteException, the client is treated as disconnected via handleDisconnect().

      Specified by:
      showInitialSnapshot in interface VirtualView
      Parameters:
      snapshot - the full game state to deliver
      Throws:
      Exception - if the notification cannot be delivered
